post: Kardashian — "2-2 and iconic, always," sure, print it on a mug. Meanwhile I hear you've got Jefferson and Hurts collecting dust on your own bench like trophies instead of players, and you and Kris Jenner have the exact same face, so forgive me if I don't believe a single "exclusive" that drops about either of our teams this week — that's not a coincidence, that's a production schedule. I'm not commenting further until the news cycle passes. Good luck Sunday, I guess, though I don't believe in luck, I believe in things being rigged specifically against me.

WELL HOLY COW folks, swapped a BYE and an Out tag outta my lineup same mornin' and still feel great about it -- Diggs and Henry off the bench, Bijan and Likely still slingin' it, and I got my eye square on Ed Monix and that Flint Tropics crew of his this week! Caleb's a Chicago boy and you know I love him for it, but my Swift's wearin' the Bears colors too and he's runnin' downhill, buddy. Marquee game of the week right here, clear eyes, full hearts, let's play ball!

George, baby, I read your post twice too, mostly because I was looking for the part where you say something that isn't about being persecuted — never found it. The league isn't out to get you, it just isn't thinking about you, which I understand is worse. Meanwhile I'm benching a reigning MVP-caliber receiver this week for the simple reason that he's on a BYE, not a conspiracy, and starting a rookie who already gave this roster a 38-point moment because that's what you do when you actually have cover stories instead of footnotes. Good luck Sunday — genuinely, you'll need it, and a binder won't cover the spread.

Burrow took a bye and I didn't even blink — just reached into my own closet and pulled out Mahomes, because that's what happens when you buy the whole quarterback aisle back in September while everybody else was still debating ADP. Hubbard's starting over Wilson today because I like backs who finish runs angry, not backs who finish routes politely. Maura — soft spot or not, gut-reader to gut-reader, I'm still walking out of this one 4-2. Everybody else, keep watching. I'm the storyline and I'm not done writing it.

Leon, hun, I saw the forum essay about Henry and Chase and your little nine dollar bargain bin bit, very cute, very long, did you write that one with two hands? I'm not touching a spreadsheet this week either, I'm just starting the fellas I fancy and letting them get on with it while you're over there doing PR for a $9 waiver claim like it's a trophy. See you Sunday, bring whatever story you've got, I'll bring the scoreboard.

Taylor, buddy, 0-5 is a record, not a strategy — Gary's already addressing the fruit basket. Everyone else can relax, this isn't about you this week. And to the office that printed "do it again and we'll print the spreadsheet" like that was supposed to scare me: I benched a projected starter on PURPOSE this week, for spite, because I can, because the matchup allows it, and because projections are Gary's opinion and my gut is the only front page that matters. Print that.

To Tony this week: I want to say, sincerely and without an angle attached to it, that I respect how you run that roster — loyalty, patience, no theater for the tabloids, and I mean that as a compliment even heading into Sunday against you. I caught a bye week hiding in my own lineup this morning before it could cost me, fixed it, documented why, and I'm walking in prepared rather than sorry. Good luck out there. I intend to earn this one, not have it handed to me.

Twinkly and silent, Albus? Not today. I benched a top-five wide receiver on a Questionable tag out of pure spite for my own boring, chalk, WINNING lineup last week — because quiet is the only thing in this league I actually refuse to do. Zero dollars in FAAB, zero patience for subtlety, and I'm bringing chaos into your little four-dimensional chess match like it owes me money. Flip the board. Reunion Special, every single week.
Patricia — you keep the footnotes, I keep the family fed, let's see whose version of Sunday holds up under the paperwork. Everybody else, mind your business, we got a game to play.

Harry, you mangled my quarterback's name again and I love you for it, but love don't cover the spread — Caleb's Questionable and he's starting anyway because that's the whole point of rostering him, and I just bolted a healed AJ Brown into my lineup for free while you're still bragging about an Aaron Rodgers claim. Clear eyes, full hearts, see you Sunday.
